newsitem.title: USA: Telecom Argentina changes ADS ratio.
newsitem.headline: Telecom Argentina changes ADS ratio.

text.p: The board of Telecom Argentina STET-France Telecom has changed the ratio of its American Depositary Shares (ADS) to ordinary shares, Morgan Guaranty Trust Co of New York, administrators of the ADS program, said Tuesday.
The new ratio is one ADS to five class B ordinary shares. The previous ratio was one ADS to 10 ordinary shares.
One additional ADS for each ADS held will be distributed to holders of record on August 21. The ADS mailing date is August 27 and is effective August 28.
Existing American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) remain valid and do not need to be exchanged for new ones.
An ADS is a share evidenced by an ADR that represents a specified number of underlying shares held in custody in the issuer's home market. The terms ADR and ADS are often used interchangeably.
